description: This file defines the SearchFragment class, a UI component responsible for handling search functionalities within the note-taking app. It manages user input, navigation to note editors, and displaying search results.

classes.name: SearchFragment
classes.description: A fragment handling search UI for notes, managing search input, displaying results, and navigation to note editing screens.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the view, sets up search input handling, and handles focus based on input.

methods.name: onNoteClick
methods.description: Handles note item clicks, navigating to the note editor with an animation.

methods.name: onNoteLongClick
methods.description: Handles long clicks on notes, showing context menu.

methods.name: onNotesChanged
methods.description: Updates the UI when the list of notes changes, including empty state indicators.
